_comment: Tokens the library sets that Material may not read, with the reason. A group may also carry 'replacedBy' (legacy token -> modern token): the audit then requires the modern token to be set AND read, so a legacy name can never be used on its own. The library supports Material ^20.0.0, so no legacy group is needed today.

groups.name: library-private
groups.reason: Variables owned by the library (read by its own snackbar wiring rules), not Material tokens. Their names are public API until 2.0.0.
